title: vleConsistency operation
description: Gibbs-Duhem thermodynamic-consistency test on MEASURED binary VLE data. Back-computes the activity coefficients from the data itself by modified Raoult (gamma_i = y_i P / (x_i Psat_i(T))), then reports the pointwise Gibbs-Duhem residual, the Herington area test (pass if |D-J| < 10) and the infinite-dilution gammas. Needs measured y: a bubble-T-vs-x set alone cannot run it, and testing an NRTL or Wilson CURVE is a tautology since those are consistent by construction. The CSV carries x1, lnGamma1, lnGamma2, lnRatio, gdResidual.

component.title: Reference component
component.description: The component whose x and y columns the dataset carries; it becomes component 1 of the binary.

partner.title: Binary partner
partner.description: The second component. REQUIRED when the package holds more than two components; inferred otherwise.

dataset.title: Measured dataset
dataset.description: Path to a self-describing dataset dict (a `columns ( { name ...; unit ...; } ... )` block plus a flat `data ( ... )` grid), relative to the case directory. Units are MANDATORY on every column.

state.title: Held state
state.description: `{ P ...; }` — the isobar the data was measured at. May also be given as a bare top-level `P`.

P.title: Pressure
P.description: The measurement isobar, when not given inside `state`.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
